name: Folder report (code mode)
description: Example for code mode and deferred tool descriptions (#1448). The step reads every file in a folder inside one program and returns a short summary, so the file contents never fill the model's context. Pick your own AI model for the step before you run it.

nodes.prompt: You help people understand what is in a folder on this computer.

nodes.label: Folder report
nodes.prompt: When the user names a folder, write ONE program with run_tool_script: list the folder with tools.filesystem.list_dir, read each text file with tools.filesystem.read_file, and return for each file its name, its number of lines and its first heading. Read the inputs of a tool with search_tools first if you need them. Then answer with a short table and one sentence about the folder.
